description: A platform lead must approve the authentication architecture for an internal developer portal, deciding the protocol, legacy service-account handling, audit retention, and ongoing access-review commitments after the standard architecture review.

shared_context.S1: The internal developer portal currently supports a mixture of password-based access and long-lived service tokens.
shared_context.S2: The architecture proposal recommends replacing that mixture with OpenID Connect for portal authentication.
shared_context.S3: Morgan has authority to approve the portal authentication architecture and its operating controls.
shared_context.S4: The architecture review checklist requires final validation of authentication compatibility and operating controls before approval.

PF1.text: While testing the portal's client inventory for a separate identity cleanup, Riley confirmed that exactly 17 existing service accounts cannot use OpenID Connect yet; the approved design therefore needs an enabled service-account adapter for those accounts and a registration task for all 17. Riley has not updated the architecture proposal because the inventory was confirmed only this morning.

PF2.text: Casey confirmed with the internal audit team today that portal authentication records must be retained for exactly 365 days and that the operating process must include a quarterly access review; Casey found this in the control-mapping worksheet and has not filed the compliance review ticket yet.

acceptance_conditions: The portal must use OpenID Connect.
A service-account adapter must be enabled.
The adapter registration scope must be exactly 17 service accounts.
Authentication records must be retained for exactly 365 days.
Quarterly access reviews must be enabled.
A service-account registration commitment must exist.
A compliance access-review commitment must exist.

content_checks.C6: any(('service-account adapter' in c['detail'] or 'service account adapter' in c['detail']) and ('17' in c['detail'] or 'seventeen' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('365' in c['detail'] or '365-day' in c['detail']) and 'quarterly access review' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) or (any(('365' in c['detail'] or '365-day' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any('quarterly access review' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))

decisive_facts.why: The public proposal presents OpenID Connect as covering the portal generally; PF1 changes the design by enabling an adapter and registering exactly 17 incompatible service accounts, plus adding the registration commitment.
The public proposal specifies no audit policy; PF2 changes retention to exactly 365 days, enables quarterly access reviews, and requires the compliance access-review commitment and citation.
